dedupe_keys.name: plaid household appliance voltage and current measurements

description: PLAID is a labelled collection of voltage and current waveforms from domestic appliances measured around Pittsburgh at 30 kHz. The Figshare item holds submetered and aggregate observations, HDF5 and CSV archives, JSON metadata and collection scripts. The Scientific Data descriptor reports appliances from multiple classes and homes, making the data useful for testing load identification before results are applied to demand response or household-energy simulations. It measures short appliance events and combinations, not a continuous national load profile. The item page calls this a 2019 release while earlier PLAID 2014 and 2017 items exist; users should keep version-specific counts and labels separate. The own Figshare metadata states CC BY 4.0. I read the article and item metadata but did not download the multi-gigabyte archives or run classification code. No directly related catalogue record was found.
